system.description:
Play the Troubadour if you want to bolster your allies through music.

Features

Gifted Performance. Describe how you perform for others. You and all allies that can hear you gain its effect. You can play each song once per Rest:

  • Relaxing Song: Clear 1 HP.
  • Inspiring Song: Gain 1 Hope.

Maestro. Your songs steel the courage of those who listen. When you give a Rally Die to an ally, they also gain a Hope or clear a Stress.
